service.description: One-time. For each nightly purge job, a live retentionDays parameter that differs from what the job shipped (15 days for generated output, 7 for raw extracts) is a production edit: its value is written to the darpan.purge.* setting (unless that setting already has a value, which then wins), and the parameter row is deleted so the setting is the one home of the period. A row equal to the shipped value is just deleted. Also deletes the stuck-run reaper job's retired staleMinutes parameter (the reaperStaleMinutes setting replaced it in DAR-BE-304; the row is ignored). A parameter that is not a valid period for its setting is reported and left. Idempotent: a second run finds no rows and changes nothing. Dry run counts and reports; it writes nothing.

set.from: [[jobName: 'purge_ReconciliationGeneratedFiles_daily', parameterName: 'retentionDays', settingKey: 'darpan.purge.generatedOutput.days', shipped: 15], [jobName: 'purge_ReconciliationExtractFiles_daily', parameterName: 'retentionDays', settingKey: 'darpan.purge.extract.days', shipped: 7]]

if.script: messages.add(mv.jobName + ' ' + mv.parameterName + ' ' + liveValue + ' left in place: not a whole number of days')
messages.add(mv.jobName + ' ' + mv.parameterName + ' ' + liveValue + ' left in place: ' + settingProblem)

else-if.script: messages.add(mv.jobName + ' ' + mv.parameterName + ' ' + liveValue + ' dropped: ' + mv.settingKey + ' already holds ' + settingRow.settingValue)

else.script: messages.add((dryRun ? 'Would set ' : 'Set ') + mv.settingKey + ' to ' + liveValue + ' (from ' + mv.jobName + ')')

if.script: darpan.admin.SettingAdminSupport.save(ec, mv.settingKey, liveValue, 'moved from the ' + mv.jobName + ' job parameter (DAR-BE-306)', serviceLabel)

else.script: messages.add(mv.jobName + ' ' + mv.parameterName + ' ' + (liveValue ?: '(blank)') + ' dropped: not an edit of the shipped ' + mv.shipped)

if.script: messages.add((dryRun ? 'Would delete' : 'Deleted') + ' sweep_StuckReconciliationRuns_10m staleMinutes ' + staleRow.parameterValue + ' (retired: the reaperStaleMinutes setting replaced it)')

set.from: [(dryRun ? 'Would change ' : 'Changed ') + rowsUpdated + ' job parameter row(s).'] + messages
